answer: Mechanism: Tide-Ripple Raven Quorum. Each reward claim samples an unpredictable public tide; the agent must act so it leaves a verifiable ripple in shared state, checked by rotating raven auditors. Auditors cluster ripple responses by controller fingerprint; correlated clone sets have all claims withheld and enter a probabilistic re-audit queue. A marginal clone therefore pays independent sensing/compute plus delayed rewards, while expected payout collapses after correlation—strictly negative-EV.
